terms_note: Original synthetic validation data created in this repository. It is not derived from third-party footage; repository project terms apply.

camera_location.label: Synthetic coordinate plane; not a physical camera
camera_location.municipality_context: São Paulo MVP configuration validation only

authorization: Repository-authored synthetic fixture authorized for automated tests and demo validation.
privacy: Contains numeric bounding boxes and aggregate ground truth only. Contains no images, people, faces, credentials, persistent identities, or real camera observations.
limitations: This fixture does not measure detector accuracy, real-world occlusion, lighting, camera shake, or São Paulo traffic conditions.
It validates deterministic tracking expiration, line-crossing direction, hysteresis, bucketing, and aggregate schema only.
The real validation annotation is manual and is not a detector-accuracy benchmark.

authorized_real_sample.privacy_reason: Only aggregate manual counts and source provenance are retained; the source video is not bundled.
